granularity_advice.subject: yolov8_nano
granularity_advice.reason: the desired granularity for yolov8_nano's dispatches should be finer: its largest dispatch (2.78 ms) exceeds dronet's available free slot (0.00 ms) (period 3.77 ms, free slot 0.00 ms after dronet's own utilization) -- it would overrun dronet's cadence if they shared a core
